te: Facts heard on a case of mass dismissal of employees
se: The meeting considered a petition concerning the dismissal of employees of an automotive parts manufacturer, inviting the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare, the Social Security Office, employer representatives and labour union representatives to give the facts, and observed that state agencies should work flexibly to suit the situation, as many employees are facing hardship
it: Petition concerning the dismissal of employees of an automotive parts manufacturer

te: Business operators heard on extending maternity leave
se: The meeting heard the views of representatives of the Thai Chamber of Commerce and Board of Trade of Thailand, the Federation of Thai Industries and small and medium-sized enterprises on the amendment in the draft labour protection law extending maternity leave from 98 to 120 days, which business operators are concerned may affect small businesses
it: Draft Labour Protection Act: extending the right to maternity leave

te: Study report on the draft labour protection law approved
se: The meeting approved the report of the Subcommittee on Labour Welfare and Protection on the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure, and resolved to invite employers to give their views and to prepare a table comparing it with the existing law
it: Study report on the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ....

te: Meeting with the Minister of Labour prepared, and the Ranong study visit summarised
se: The meeting prepared its call on the Minister of Labour on 25 December 2024, and noted the results of the study visit to Ranong Province, including the seminar on "Managing Foreign Workers in Ranong Province" on 3 December 2024
it: Call on the Minister of Labour (25 December 2024)
Results of the study visit and seminar on managing foreign workers in Ranong Province

te: A former employee's petition, and the work plan for 2025
se: The meeting considered a petition in which a former employee of an establishment alleged unfair treatment, and assigned the Subcommittee on Labour Welfare and Protection to consider it. It approved the work plan for fiscal year 2025, adding the management of foreign workers, prepared a study visit to Ranong Province (2–4 December 2024), and followed up the study on digital platform workers
it: Petition on a dispute of a former employee of an establishment
Work plan for fiscal year 2025 (adding the management of foreign workers)
Study visit to Ranong Province, 2–4 December 2024
Study of digital platform workers

te: Draft labour protection law studied on 5 issues
se: The meeting studied the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... on 5 issues: the rights of employees hired by state agencies through contractors, extending maternity leave from 98 to 120 days, 15 more days of leave when a child is ill, 15 days of leave to care for a wife and child after birth, and submitting documents electronically
it: Study of the draft Labour Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. ....

te: 5 study topics approved on job placement and skills development
se: The meeting approved 5 study topics of the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development: digital platform workers, employing older persons, workers in tourism and Thai massage, promoting work abroad, and improving laws on migrant workers, and appointed 4 more advisers
it: 5 study topics of the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development
Appointment of 4 additional advisers

te: Assistants appointed, and the subcommittees followed up
se: The meeting considered appointing persons to assist the work of the committee and its subcommittees, and noted the progress of the work of all 3 subcommittees
it: Appointment of persons to assist the committee and its subcommittees
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

se: The meeting appointed 4 committee secretaries and 8 more advisers to the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development, to help with the committee's studies
it: Appointment of 4 committee secretaries
Appointment of 8 advisers to the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development

te: Duties of the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development set
se: The meeting approved the 6-point scope of duties of the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development, which will meet every Monday, and appointed additional advisers to the subcommittee
it: Scope of duties of the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development (6 points)
Appointment of additional advisers to the subcommittee

te: A petition requesting information, an approach to the budget, and advisers appointed
se: The meeting considered a petition asking for help in obtaining information from agencies, and assigned the Subcommittee on Social Security to consider it. It discussed how to follow up the labour-related annual expenditure budget for fiscal year 2025, appointed advisers and experts, and noted the progress of its subcommittees
it: Petition asking for help in obtaining information from agencies
Approach to following up the 2025 labour budget
Appointment of advisers and experts
Progress of the subcommittees' work followed up

te: Rules set for sending representatives to other committees
se: The meeting considered the rules for nominating representatives of the Committee on Labour to serve as members of other Senate committees, so that coordination between committees is appropriate
it: Rules for nominating the committee's representatives to other committees

te: Approach to work set, and 3 subcommittees set up
se: The meeting discussed the committee's approach to its work and resolved to set up 3 subcommittees: on Employment Services and Skills Development; on Social Security (chaired by Mr. Chinnachot Saengsank); and on Labour Welfare and Protection. It also appointed the committee's advisers
it: The committee's approach to its work
Setting up 3 subcommittees
Appointment of the committee's advisers

te: Information prepared in support of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly General Assembly
se: The meeting noted the fire evacuation guidance and the measures to reduce paper use under the Green Office project, and assigned the secretariat to prepare information, views and Thailand's position on draft resolutions related to labour, in support of the 45th General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (17–23 October 2024, Vientiane, Lao People's Democratic Republic). It also set how meeting notices are to be signed
it: Fire evacuation guidance and measures to reduce paper use
Information in support of the 45th General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly
Signing of meeting notices

te: Chair and other officers of the committee elected
se: At its first meeting, the committee elected Mr. Virat Rakpan as Chair, Mr. Nirutti Suttinon as First Vice-Chair and Pol.Lt.Col. Suriya Barasun as Second Vice-Chair, together with the other vice-chairs, secretary, spokespersons and advisers under the Rules of Procedure, and assigned the Chair to represent the committee on the Special Committee on Senate Affairs
it: Election of the chair, vice-chairs and other officers of the committee
Nomination of the committee's representative to the Special Committee on Senate Affairs

te: Working group set up to study the management of foreign workers
se: The meeting felt that the management of foreign workers raises issues that should be considered quickly, so it resolved to set up a working group to study the matter, and assigned it to prepare a report on the study visit to Ranong Province
it: Setting up a working group to study the management of foreign workers
Report on the study visit to Ranong Province
